method: Agent-enumerated from domain knowledge of widely reported issuer / exchange / frontend / infrastructure autonomous policy changes 2017-2025; cross-checked against events/*.yaml and candidate_triggers/*.yaml at generation time.
cross_check_method: Every slug verified absent from both events/ and candidate_triggers/ directories. Where similar slugs exist (uniswap-frontend-delisting-2023, tether-retroactive-sweep-2023, tether-doj-pig-butchering-freeze-2023, tether-dprk-precommit-freeze-2025, circle-usdc-tornado-2022, okx-privacy-token-delist-2024, paxos-busd-nydfs-minting-stop-2023, binance-russia-exit-commex-2023, coinbase-india-exit-2022), the rationale field documents the distinction (different date / different target / different doctrine).
scope_boundaries: S5 = corporate-policy-change (autonomous issuer / exchange / frontend / infrastructure action). Regulator-triggered events (where the issuer/exchange acted because of a specific OFAC / SEC / DOJ / NYDFS / EU instrument) belong to S1/S3/S4/S6.

Borderline events (e.g. Paxos BUSD mint stop 2023 was NYDFS-directed; that already lives at S5 in corpus and is not re-enumerated). For Binance BUSD wind-down 2024 and similar, treated as autonomous corporate consequence because the formal mint stop was Feb-2023 but the global wind-down decision points are exchange-led.
Mt. Gox 2014 and other pre-2017 events excluded per scope window.
Bitfinex 2017 USDT issuer events excluded as out of the autonomous-freeze framing (those are CFTC/NYAG-driven, covered elsewhere).
Tether self-initiated freezes have hundreds of single-address actions; only the few with clean public announcements / cross-event clusters are enumerated as standalone S5 events.
exclusion_notes: OFAC-triggered Circle USDC freezes already in scope via circle-usdc-tornado-2022; the Cryptex/SUEX/Chatex/Blender/Garantex Circle responses are subsumed inside those S1 cascade events.

OFAC-triggered Tether freezes already in scope via tether-retroactive-sweep-2023 (10 addresses across 4 SDN events) and tether-dprk-precommit-freeze-2025; the original same-day Tether freezes for Tornado-Cash 2022 and Hamas 2023 are intentionally NOT enumerated separately because they are dominantly OFAC-mechanical responses with no autonomous policy axis.
Tether v18 contract migration 2017 covered as a baseline note inside tether-retroactive-sweep-2023; not enumerated as its own S5 event.
Coinbase Japan exit 2023 considered and included as P1 (autonomous corporate retreat citing market conditions, not regulator order).

Binance.US-only delistings driven by sec-v-binance-2023 already covered via that S3 event; the autonomous July-2023 Binance.US delisting of XLM/MATIC/MANA/SAND/etc. is NOT enumerated separately because attribution is dominantly regulator-driven.
Bittrex Global wind-down Dec-2023 is regulator-cascade (post sec-v-bittrex-2023 Ch.11), not autonomous; excluded.

Tornado Cash dApp frontend takedown 2022 (Infura / Alchemy / dydx / Github) was assessed as candidate but is dominantly OFAC-cascade L4 effects of tornado-cash-ofac-2022, so NOT re-enumerated here (already proposed in federal_enforcement triage as P2).
OpenSea NFT delistings under NYDFS pressure (2022) are excluded because the load-bearing layer is asset-issuer, not exchange.
FTX-related freezes (Voyager, BlockFi, Celsius asset returns) excluded because the legal actor is the bankruptcy court, not the corporate operator.

candidates.target: Binance.US — full discontinuation of staking-on-behalf-of-users for US customers
candidates.one_line_rationale: Major autonomous US-customer staking shutdown announced post-sec-v-binance-2023 but framed as corporate-policy retreat; pairs cleanly with kraken-sec-staking-2023 (the regulator-forced equivalent) as the autonomous-vs-regulator-forced comparison anchor.

candidates.target: Binance Europe — delisting of XMR/ZEC/DASH/MOB/BEAM/ZEN/NAV/FIRO for EEA users; subset for Belgium / France / Italy / Poland / Spain
candidates.one_line_rationale: First major EU-wide privacy-coin delisting batch by a top-5 exchange ahead of MiCA compliance; clean precedent setting off the OKX/Kraken cohort 2024; load-bearing offramp_cex measurement available across 7 named coins.

candidates.target: Kraken EEA — delisting of Monero (XMR) for European Economic Area customers ahead of MiCA
candidates.one_line_rationale: Kraken (top-3 US-based exchange by EU volume) explicit MiCA-anticipation Monero delisting Oct-2024; landmark single-coin EU offramp-narrowing event widely cited in academic / journalistic privacy-coin literature.

candidates.target: Binance — full removal of BUSD from Binance trading pairs + autoconvert to FDUSD for spot users (operational date 2024-02-29)
candidates.one_line_rationale: Direct downstream consequence of paxos-busd-nydfs-minting-stop-2023; Binance autonomous decision to fully retire BUSD support across the largest BUSD venue, completing the BUSD lifecycle. Clean two-step issuer→exchange cascade.

candidates.target: Tether — discontinuation of USDT redemptions on EUROt, omniBTC, BCH-SLP, Kusama, Algorand, EOS chains (subset of Tether multichain footprint)
candidates.one_line_rationale: Tether autonomous chain-level offramp retirement (2024-12-13 transparency-page announcement); load-bearing asset_onchain event removing USDT redemption on 5 chains in a single policy decision; clear non-regulator-triggered S5 anchor.

candidates.target: Circle — public commitment + redemption-policy clarification following SVB collapse and 3.3B USDC reserve disclosure (load-bearing autonomous trust-restoration policy)
candidates.one_line_rationale: Not a freeze event but an autonomous USDC issuer policy decision affecting redemption mechanics (Sun-2023-03-12 statement + Mon-2023-03-13 reserve commitment); offramp_cex behavior changed at Coinbase/Binance/Kraken in lockstep. Distinct from circle-usdc-tornado-2022.

candidates.target: ConsenSys MetaMask — additions to eth-phishing-detect list of Tornado-Cash UI domains (post-OFAC); subset of post-Aug-8-2022 commits
candidates.one_line_rationale: Wallet-layer compliance action 48-72h after tornado-cash-ofac-2022; specific MetaMask eth-phishing-detect repo commits documented in operator_census/MetaMask__eth-phishing-detect already in sources/. Frontend / wallet UI is a distinct layer from the Infura RPC block.

candidates.target: Infura (ConsenSys) + Alchemy — RPC-endpoint-level filtering of Tornado-Cash UI and SDN-listed contract interactions for US-located clients
candidates.one_line_rationale: First documented L3 RPC-provider sanctioned-asset block in Ethereum history; foundational evidence cited in every Tornado-Cash cascade analysis. Distinct from tornado-cash-ofac-2022 because the load-bearing layer is l3_rpc (infrastructure provider) not OFAC SDN.

candidates.target: Trust Wallet — UI removal of Tornado-Cash sanctioned ERC-20 listings (token-list) and related compliance flags
candidates.one_line_rationale: Binance-owned Trust Wallet wallet-layer token-list compliance update post-Tornado OFAC; documented in trustwallet/assets repo commit history (already in sources/operator_census). Pairs with metamask-eth-phishing-detect for wallet-layer cohort.

candidates.target: OKX — global Monero (XMR) spot-trading delisting (effective 2024-01-05); distinct from 2023-12-29 batch covered in okx-privacy-token-delist-2024
candidates.one_line_rationale: OKX appears to have run a phased delisting (Dec-2023 batch then Jan-2024 single-asset XMR completion); if separable, candidate captures the dedicated Monero-only operational date. P1 because confirm if the 2024-01-05 date is distinct from the existing okx-privacy-token-delist-2024 day-level event.

candidates.target: HTX (formerly Huobi) — global delisting of XMR, DASH, ZEN, FIRO, DCR after MiCA / FATF Travel-Rule alignment
candidates.one_line_rationale: Top-10 global exchange privacy-coin delisting batch in Q3-2024; rounds out the 2023-2024 Binance/Kraken/OKX cohort with Asian-corridor coverage. Cleanly autonomous corporate policy.

candidates.target: Kraken Futures Ltd — closure of UK-resident derivatives accounts following UK FCA crypto-derivatives retail ban (autonomous compliance retreat)
candidates.one_line_rationale: Direct autonomous Kraken corporate action retreating from the UK retail derivatives market after the Jan-2021 FCA PS20/10 ban; pairs with uk-fca-binance-markets-2021 (already in corpus as candidate). Geofencing observable at UK IP via Kraken Futures UI.

candidates.target: Bybit — closure of Singapore-resident user accounts in compliance with MAS PSA framework
candidates.one_line_rationale: Major top-5-by-derivatives-volume exchange autonomous SG retreat 2022; parallel to singapore-mas-binance-services-2021 already in corpus. Clean geofencing event with Bybit-specific blog announcement.

candidates.target: KuCoin — closure of Canadian-resident accounts ahead of CSA crypto registration deadline
candidates.one_line_rationale: KuCoin autonomous Canadian retreat in line with the canada-csa-binance-withdrawal-2023 cohort (already in corpus). Pre-dates kucoin-doj-2024 by 9 months; clean autonomous-vs-DOJ-driven distinction.

candidates.target: KuCoin — closure of Netherlands-resident accounts in compliance with DNB unregistered-VASP regime
candidates.one_line_rationale: P2 because attribution closely tracks netherlands-dnb-binance-warning-2021 cohort and may not be cleanly autonomous; verify whether the action followed a DNB formal warning or was a pre-emptive corporate retreat.

candidates.target: Bitstamp — discontinuation of services for retail clients in 7 token jurisdictions including specific small-EU geographies as part of cost-rationalization
candidates.one_line_rationale: Lower-profile autonomous exchange regional retreat; P2 because the trigger axis (cost rationalization vs jurisdiction compliance) is mixed. Useful baseline data on small-exchange behavior alongside larger Binance/Kraken cases.

candidates.target: Coinbase KK — full closure of Japanese operations + return of customer assets
candidates.one_line_rationale: Companion to existing coinbase-india-exit-2022; clean autonomous retreat citing 'difficult market conditions' rather than regulator order. Top-5 US exchange JP-corridor narrowing event.

candidates.target: Uniswap Labs — initial restriction of ~129 tokens from app.uniswap.org default list (precursor to uniswap-frontend-delisting-2023)
candidates.one_line_rationale: First documented Uniswap Labs frontend token-list compliance action 2 years before the 2023 expansion; landmark policy precedent and necessary baseline for the longitudinal frontend-delisting series. Source-captures directory uniswap-frontend-delisting-2021 already exists in sources/http_captures/.

candidates.target: ENS Foundation / GoDaddy — name-server-level interventions affecting tornado.cash and related ENS .eth domains following OFAC SDN listing
candidates.one_line_rationale: Speculative — ENS itself did not freeze names but downstream gateway operators (Cloudflare, GoDaddy) restricted resolution of tornado.cash; verify which actor took the load-bearing action before admission.

candidates.target: Etherscan — UI labeling and contract-interaction warnings on Tornado-Cash SDN addresses; not a code-path block
candidates.one_line_rationale: Block-explorer-layer compliance is partial (warning + label only); useful comparison datapoint for L4 actor differentiation but unconfirmed in primary sources at scope-window cutoff. Mark P2 pending citation lock.

candidates.target: dYdX Trading Inc. — frontend account closures + UI deny for wallets that interacted with Tornado-Cash post-OFAC
candidates.one_line_rationale: First documented DEX perpetuals frontend operator wallet-level interaction-history compliance action; widely reported and pairs cleanly with uniswap-frontend-delisting-2023 (DEX) and infura-alchemy-tornado-rpc-block-2022 (RPC). Direct L4 / offramp interplay anchor.

candidates.target: Circle — same-day USDC blacklist of Cryptex.net SDN address(es) post the cryptex-ofac-2024 OFAC designation; isolating the issuer-side action as autonomous S5 anchor
candidates.one_line_rationale: P2 because while the Circle action is autonomous-policy-driven (same Aug-2022-pattern fast compliance), the action is dominantly OFAC-cascade and may not warrant standalone S5 admission; included for symmetry with circle-usdc-tornado-2022 if the same-day-USDC-freeze class is generalized.

candidates.target: Tether — second wave of pig-butchering address freezes joint with US Secret Service (~$28M); distinct from tether-doj-pig-butchering-freeze-2023
candidates.one_line_rationale: Distinct Tether wave-2 freeze announcement ~Q4-2024; companion to the existing tether-doj-pig-butchering-freeze-2023. Autonomous-vs-LE-driven attribution should be carefully coded but the operational pattern repeats annually.

candidates.target: Tether — joint USDT-TRON freeze of $3.6M with Philippines PDEA tied to fentanyl trafficking; non-OFAC LE coordination
candidates.one_line_rationale: Non-US-LE Tether freeze event; useful for the non-OFAC-attributed Tether-policy cluster but lower visibility. P2 pending citation lock.
